answer: The preventive officer posts watchmen at the smuggler's cove by rota and signs each rota, and no watchman may stand a post his name is not on. A forge watchman standing a post he was never given fails the rota: the timber of the cove must hold the men the officer posted, and a false watchman lets the boats through. Faking the rota means bribing the preventive officer, forging 200 rotas and paying 18,600, while the atlas signature on the rota is checked at every change of watch, so a watchman whose post was never signed is marched off the cliff path.
